n8657852607.ds: Clos de Gat is situated in foothills of the Judean Mountains, Bordering Israel’s biblical Ayalon Valley, where Joshua defeated the five kings. An ancient “Gat” (Hebrew for winepress), pre-dating the Roman period, Is located in the grounds of the modern winery.

n9396409435.ds: "וּבַגֶּ֖פֶן, שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה שָׂרִיגִ֑ם; וְהִ֤וא כְפֹרַ֙חַת֙ עָלְתָ֣ה נִצָּ֔הּ, הִבְשִׁ֥ילוּ אַשְׁכְּלֹתֶ֖יהָ עֲנָבִֽים" בראשית, פרק מ', פסוק י' פתוח רק בימי שבת!
